subject: ACME - Procurement & security qualification / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@acme.com>, Mark Chen <mark.chen@acme.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01T16:15:00-08:00
Subject: ACME - Procurement & security qualification / next steps

Hi Sara / Mark —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary of today's call:
- Use case: ACME wants to integrate Redwood Inference for customer-facing summarization and search ranking (internally prioritized).
- Expected initial footprint: 3k-5k monthly active users, bursty traffic for nightly batch jobs.
- Procurement gating: need SOC 2 Type II report, executed DPA, and answers to a short security questionnaire before legal can sign.
- Commercial path: Procurement is evaluating whether to pay by PO (annual) or corporate card (one-off); also assessing interest in purchasing via AWS Marketplace.

Immediate next steps (my proposed owners):
1) I will send our SOC 2 Type II report, DPA template, and a completed security questionnaire for their review (Marissa).
2) Sara to confirm whether ACME prefers PO vs card and timeline for PO approval (Sara).
3) I will provide a draft SOW/quote and DocuSign link once we agree on term and pricing; we can support either PO or card; marketplace listing is available if desired (Marissa).
4) Rishi / PM to confirm any commercial flexibility (Rishi) — I copied Rishi and Dev for pricing/technical clarifications.

Attachments I will share in the next email: SOC2 report, DPA, and the filled questionnaire.

If that looks right, can you confirm procurement preference and target PO date?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Chen <mark.chen@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ACME - Procurement & security qualification / next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few updates from procurement/legal side: 

- SOC 2 and a DPA are mandatory before legal will sign. Please send both; procurement will do a short review and then route to our cloud security team for the questionnaire.
- Payment path: procurement prefers an annual PO wherever possible. If there are commercial constraints on PO timing, we can consider corporate card for an initial pilot, but the goal is to move to a PO for production.
- Marketplace: would be helpful if you’re available on AWS Marketplace — our procurement sometimes prefers that route for faster processing, but it’s not a hard requirement.

Can you share: SOC 2 Type II report, your standard DPA, and a completed copy of your security questionnaire? Also please include an indicative SOW/quote (line-item pricing) and an estimated lead time for PO issuance (e.g., 2–4 weeks after procurement review).

Thanks — I’ll sync with Mark and confirm internal PO timeline.

Best,
Sara Lopez
Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
Sara.Lopez@acme.com
\

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@acme.com>, Mark Chen <mark.chen@acme.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ACME - Procurement & security qualification / next steps

Sara — appreciate the quick reply. Attaching the items you requested and a draft quote. See attachments below: 
- redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report)
- Redwood_DPA_2026.docx (standard DPA)
- security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx (completed questionnaire — we answered the items your cloud security team flagged last week)
- ACME_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW with line-item pricing and term options)

Notes on commercial options: 
- PO: we can accept annual PO. Typical processing time we see from similar customers is 2–6 weeks once procurement has the DPA and SOC 2. If you can share your PO routing details (who needs to sign internally), we can flag the right legal/compliance contacts to speed review.
- Card: supported for pilot months if procurement needs to buy quickly; we’ll invoice through Stripe and move to PO later.
- Marketplace: we are listed on AWS Marketplace (Private Offers available). If you want marketplace procurement, we can create a private offer to simplify the PO flow — let me know and I’ll engage our marketplace team.

DocuSign: I can prepare a DocuSign envelope for the SOW/quote once you confirm PO vs card and the term length.

Next ask from you: please confirm preferred payment route (PO vs card) and an estimated PO approval timeframe — I’ll queue our commercial/finance team accordingly.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf (PDF), Redwood_DPA_2026.docx (DOCX), security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx (XLSX), ACME_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: ACME commercial flexibility and approval for marketplace/PO concessions

Rishi / Dev —

ACME procurement came back asking for SOC2 and DPA (attached). They prefer an annual PO but may start on card for pilot. They’re also open to AWS Marketplace.

Request: can we offer up to 20% off list for an annual 12-month PO (term commit) to land the expansion? If not, what floor do you want me to quote? Also confirm we can support a private offer on AWS Marketplace if asked.

I attached the draft SOW and the filled questionnaire. I’m planning to offer the SOW at list pricing with the option to apply a 20% annual-commit discount if you approve.

Thanks,
Marissa

(Attachments: ACME_SOW_v1.pdf, security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T11:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: ACME commercial flexibility and approval for marketplace/PO concessions

Marissa —

You have approval to offer up to 20% off list for a 12-month annual PO. Rationale: mid-market account, strong expansion signal, and pilot expected to convert to production. Ensure quote includes clear renewal pricing and that discount is contingent on signed PO within 45 days.

We can support AWS Marketplace Private Offers; loop in our marketplace ops if ACME requests a private offer (I’ll introduce Priya from marketplace ops). DPA and SOC2 are current and approved for procurement review — legal has no open exceptions.

OK to proceed with DocuSign for the SOW once Sara confirms PO vs card.

Rishi
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
